description: This file provides a mock implementation of a product data provider, exporting a function getMockProducts() that returns an array of sample product objects. These products include details such as id, name, category, description, image URL, price, weight or quality, discount information, instant delivery info, and stock quantity. The data appears intended for use in a frontend application for a grocery shopping platform, with emphasis on product display, discounts, and Instant delivery features.

methods.name: getMockProducts()
methods.description: Returns a list of sample product objects with various properties such as id, name, category, description, image URL, price, weight or quality, discount info, instant delivery info, and stock quantity.
